name: grant-reporting-assistant
description: Rebuild grant-report tables from your client data in a Claude chat, with your normal Claude login and no API key. Client records stay on your computer.
long_description:
Grant Reporting Assistant (GRA) rebuilds the tables of a past grant report, or a funder's requirements, for a new reporting period from your organization's client and case data.

GRA imports the data files into a protected database on your computer. Claude sees only the report, a description of the data with no client details, and totals from GRA's privacy-checked queries, never individual records, names, IDs or notes. Every figure comes from a query on your computer, and GRA saves the finished tables as Word and Excel files, with an AI activity report of everything Claude was shown.

Ask Claude, for example: "Use Grant Reporting Assistant to rebuild my 2025 report for 2026. The report and data are in Documents\Grant data." To try it first, ask: "Run the Grant Reporting Assistant sample report."

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: List the report and data files in a folder (names only).

tools.name: preview_data
tools.description: Show what GRA keeps private and what it may share.

tools.name: start_report
tools.description: Import the data on this computer and start a report.

tools.name: start_sample_report
tools.description: Try GRA on its fictional sample.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Run a privacy-checked count; only totals come back.

tools.name: note_assumption
tools.description: Record an assumption, gap or warning.

tools.name: submit_tables
tools.description: Check the finished tables and save Word and Excel files.

tools.name: show_results
tools.description: Show the finished tables and saved files again.

read_folders.title: Folders GRA may read
read_folders.description: GRA only opens reports and data files inside these folders. Add the folder that holds your files if it is somewhere else, such as a shared or Google Drive folder.

output_folder.title: Save finished reports in
output_folder.description: GRA makes a "Grant Reporting Assistant" folder here for the Word and Excel files.
